_comment: One unit of competency. It exists as a file because the catalogue lists a unit — and Moodle gets a grade item for it — only once this file ships. The lessons below were READ OFF the built pages' data-criteria, not asserted here, so this cannot drift from what is actually taught.
title: Prepare timber to size
taughtBy: Marking Out and Cutting a Halving Joint

criteria.text: Select timber for a job, softwood or hardwood, large enough that unnecessary joints are avoided.
Mark raw timber to the required dimensions, leaving allowance for sawing and planing.
Plane a face side straight, then a face edge straight and square to it, and mark both.
criteria.evidence: Assessor sign-off; checked with try square and straight edge.

criteria.text: Set a marking gauge from the face side and face edge to gauge width and thickness.
Plane to the gauge lines to reach final dimensions, sawing first where the waste is heavy.
